name: Binary Search
ground_truth: Repeatedly halves a sorted search interval by comparing the target with the median element.

analogies.analogy: Imagine looking up a word in a 1,000-page dictionary. You open directly to the middle (page 500). If your word comes earlier alphabetically, you ignore the entire second half.
analogies.mapping_question: Why does this strategy only work if the dictionary is in alphabetical order?
